correctness.rationale: Theorem 14 of arxiv:2309.15047v1 provides a complete harmonic-wavelet basis. A new level-by-level cancellation proof shows each bounded horocyclic multiplier has vanishing cross-wavelet inner products; descendant counting gives the exact normalized positive kernel. The geometric-series rational identity is verified symbolically. The bilateral shift factors have Neumann inverses because r,rs,rs²<1. Q(-z) has positive Taylor coefficients, so its convolution inverse has exactly the stated ℓ∞ norm, attained by alternating signs. Complete labelled spectrum and noncompactness follow from infinite multiplicity. The supplementary checker verifies the algebra and finite wavelet computations, not infinite completeness; assumptions and boundary limits are stated.

value.rationale: Level-dependent Toeplitz compressions form a geometrically natural full operator algebra on a horocyclic discrete hyperbolic model. The theorem solves the all-bounded-symbol forward eigenvalue and inverse labelled-data problems, with a sharp globally attained stability constant and a nontrivial singular α↓1 transition. The spectral-set-only ambiguity is explicitly excluded. This goes materially beyond rephrasing the known wavelet basis.
